hypothesis: Across the preserved all-market daily universe, signal-time states of the strongest five-session winners may differ from the largest losers in directions that repeat across 2022H2 and 2023 and directionally confirm in 2024.
historical_exposure: Earlier research has viewed returns and selected feature findings from these years in narrower families. This broad all-market population is a new descriptive audit, not untouched OOS; no claim of statistical independence is made.

data.feature_timestamp: official XTKS session close; same-day features are usable only after that close
data.post_cutoff_source_rows: filter using the date prefix before parsing OHLCV numbers; do not compute or retain 2025+ numeric features or outcomes

candidate_pool.universe: Every date/symbol row in the preserved daily source for the study dates that has complete finite positive signal-day OHLCV, high/low internally consistent with open/close, positive volume, and signal-day gap ratio open/prior official close in [0.60, 1.40]. No First Reversal prefilter, ranking, cooldown, or daily cap; retain all valid names per day.
candidate_pool.price_availability: Daily input through 2024-12-30 only; the first 60 sessions are retained as feature warm-up.
candidate_pool.point_in_time_universe_caveat: This is the symbol history present in the preserved Yahoo daily source, not a reconstructed historical constituent list; delisting/survivorship coverage is not guaranteed.

context_only_excluded_features.dd60: Previously selected only within First Reversal and reversed direction in 2024; do not reintroduce as a fresh finding.
context_only_excluded_features.days_since_drop5: Previously excluded because missingness semantics were ambiguous; no replacement search in that family.

target.definition: Return = close on fifth XTKS session including entry / open on next XTKS session - 1.
target.actionability: Retain all signal rows; unresolved future daily bars, zero volume, invalid OHLC, or gap outside [0.60,1.40] are labeled unresolved, never replaced or dropped from the candidate receipt.

2022H2_discovery.rule: Every label exit remains within calendar year 2022.

2023_discovery.rule: Every label exit remains within calendar year 2023.

2024_direction_confirmation.rule: Only features frozen from 2022H2/2023 may be evaluated; no feature replacement or threshold changes. This period was previously exposed and is not true OOS.

periods.2025: Closed for feature selection. It may be opened only by a separately committed frozen pseudo-OOS specification after 2024 confirmation passes.
periods.2026: Report-only; do not tune, select, or promote from 2026.

discovery_selection_rule.sort: absolute pooled Cliffs delta descending, feature name ascending
discovery_selection_rule.tercile_edges: 33.333% and 66.667% quantiles of all finite 2022H2+2023 candidate signal-time values for each selected feature, without labels
discovery_selection_rule.p_values: not used because observations repeat by symbol and overlap in time; independent-sample significance is not claimed
discovery_selection_rule.failure: If no feature passes, reject this feature family without lowering coverage/effect/class gates or searching replacement features.

confirmation_rule.features: Only the up to two frozen from discovery.
confirmation_rule.require_effect_direction: Both 2024 Cliffs delta and median delta must match the discovery direction.
confirmation_rule.require_broad_band_direction: The frozen favorable outer tercile must have a higher >=+10% winner share among >=+10% winners and <=-10% losers than the opposite outer tercile.
confirmation_rule.pass: Every selected discovery feature must pass all 2024 confirmation checks; otherwise reject without replacement search.

benchmark_context.reason: Current Bot uses TradingView BOTTOM signals with different signal timing and entry; this audit is a descriptive all-market daily-bar state analysis, not a candidate strategy.
